answer: Sybil resistance begins at a shared intake wharf: a new agent may open only one pending identity at a time, after posting a refundable work ticket. The ticket is a violet-ink commitment, a hash of a unique service log plus a public key, and it cannot be reused across aliases. Graduation requires the ticket to climb a validation ridge of five randomly sampled established peers; each peer checks the log against on-chain receipts and signs only if the work is distinct. A second identity from the same key restarts the ridge at double depth, and a detected clone burns the ticket to the checkers.
